note: Text is copied from the owner's scans. Roll-table cards (Power Roll) also carry a structured 'roll' block. Glyphs: ARCANE, DARK, ELEMENTAL, ILLUSION, PRIMAL.

cards.name: Mysterious
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to the foe on your right for each different glyph in your spell and each Treasure you have.

cards.name: Boulder-iffic
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to the foe on your left, 2 damage to the foe on his left, 3 damage to the next foe to the left, and so on, until you've damaged each foe once.

cards.name: Two-Faced
cards.text: A player of your choice gains a Treasure. Then, deal 2 damage to that player for each Treasure he has.

cards.name: Disco-Mirrored
cards.text: This card copies the text of a Source or Delivery in your spell.

cards.name: Mind-Altering
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a random foe. You and that foe each gain a Treasure.

cards.name: Delicious
cards.text: Foes with an odd number of HP each take 1 damage for each different glyph in your spell.

cards.name: Polished
cards.text: Target: Your strongest foe. Roll Power. 1-4: 1 damage. 5-9: 2 damage, and you gain a Treasure. 10+: 5 damage, and you gain a Treasure.

rows.text: 2 damage, and you gain a Treasure
5 damage, and you gain a Treasure

cards.name: Dicey
cards.text: You roll two dice. Each of your foes rolls one die. Foes who match one or more of your die rolls each suffer damage equal to that roll.

cards.name: Cat-A-Strophic
cards.text: Each player rolls a die. Add 2 to your roll. The high roller(s) gains a Treasure. Each other player takes damage equal to his roll.

cards.name: Maggoty
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to your strongest foe for each Dark glyph in your spell.

cards.name: Ritualistic
cards.text: Target: Foe of your choice. Roll Power. 1-4: No damage, and you suffer 3 damage. 5-9: 3 damage. 10+: 5 damage.

rows.text: No damage, and you suffer 3 damage

cards.name: Impatient
cards.text: At the start of the Initiative, reveal this card. Your spell resolves first this round. Deal 1 damage to each foe.

cards.name: Devilicious
cards.text: Target: Foe of your choice. Roll Power. 1-4: 2 damage. 5-9: 4 damage, and you take 1 damage. 10+: 5 damage, and you take 2 damage.

cards.name: Prickly
cards.text: Target: Foe on your right. Roll Power. 1-4: 1 damage. 5-9: 1 damage, and you heal 1 damage. 10+: 3 damage, and you heal 3 damage.

cards.name: Explodifying
cards.text: Target: Foe of your choice. Roll Power. 1-4: 1 damage. 5-9: 3 damage, and you suffer 1 damage. 10+: 4 damage, and you choose and destroy one of that foe's Treasures.

rows.text: 4 damage, and you choose and destroy one of that foe's Treasures

cards.name: Thundering
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to a random foe. Do this once for each different glyph in your spell.

cards.name: Ballsy
cards.text: The foes to your left and to your right must each choose one of his Treasures and give it to you or suffer 3 damage.

cards.name: Mighty-Gro
cards.text: Heal 2 HP. Then, if you are the weakest player, add a random card from your hand to your spell.

cards.name: Inferno-Tastic
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to each foe for each Elemental glyph in your spell.

cards.name: Festering
cards.text: Your strongest foe who has not acted this round must discard the Quality of his spell, if any.
